description:
Hello fellow frontend/React developers.

Neho, a digital real-estate agency working in the Swiss proptech industry is looking for an experienced freelance ReactJS developer to join our existing team in Alba Iulia or remote

Requirements:

At least 5 years of experience as a frontend developer

At least 3 years experience with ReactJS

Very good knowledge of CSS/SASS HTML5 and experience in working with Bootstrap5 and webpack/vite

A good level of english is required, french is an advantage

Nice to have:

Some working knowledge with Laravel or other known PHP frameworks

Please send us a CV and/or a github repo of your works along with the date of availability.
